text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. Start by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting your own mini-deadlines. Prioritization is also important: decide which tasks are most urgent and focus on them first. If you realize you cannot finish everything, use scope management. This means reducing what you include in the project or asking for a smaller, simpler result. Finally, communication is key. Tell your manager, teacher, or team early if you see a problem, and suggest a new plan. When you speak up honestly instead of hiding the issue, people can usually help you find a solution.
